page.overview:
Who is Ted Bowehim?

Dr. Ted Bowehim is a minor character in Jurassic World, played by Elsburgh Clarke III. Bowehim was one of Dr. Henry Wu's geneticists.

Bowehim was one of Dr. Henry Wu's scientists at the Hammond Creation Lab in 2015.
